parsed.restated: ∃ S : Set (Space n), Convex ℝ S ∧ IsCompact S ∧ (interior S).Nonempty ∧ barycenter S = 0 ∧ interiorLatticePoints S = {0} ∧ ((volume : Measure (Space n)) S).toReal = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
parsed.proof:
constructor
· rintro ⟨K, h⟩
  exact ⟨K.carrier, K.convex, K.compact, K.fullDimensional, K.centered, K.uniqueInteriorLatticePoint, h⟩
· rintro ⟨S, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  exact ⟨⟨S, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, h6⟩
parsed.english: There is a convex, compact set S in ℝⁿ with nonempty interior, barycenter 0, whose only interior integer point is the origin, and whose Lebesgue volume equals (n+1)^n / n!.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the CenteredBody structure into its defining conditions and the volume/sharpConstant definitions into explicit formulas, so no bespoke structure has to be looked up.
